lines.trans: Senya, did you bring that special remedy?
Yes, chef, this is a strong remedy.
This is brand new powerful medicine.
How quickly does it start to act?
Very quickly, chef, literally right away.
One pill solves all your problems.
And what will be the exact effect?
I promise, the customer will not leave the toilet!
Excellent, the judge will remember this anniversary!
Shall we add the pill into her soup?
No, we will put the powder directly on the goose.
The main thing is that other guests do not get poisoned.
Do not fear, I will do everything personally.
